verses.text: Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Josué icha tik: Manh ach xiwok, mokab' chab'axk'e a k'o'ol. Ik'b'at masanil heb' winh soldado, tzach b'at owal t'a chonhab' Hai. Ha in ol wak'och jun chonhab' chi' yet' winh sreyal yet' masanil smakb'en t'a yol he k'ab'.

Icha wal ix eyutej chonhab' Jericó yet' winh sreyal, icha pax chi' ol eyutej jun chonhab' chi' yet' winh sreyal. Haxo pax masanil tastak ay t'ay yet' nok' nok', tzeyikejkani ayik toxo ix eyak' ganar. Ak'b'at junok makan heb' winh soldado yik sb'at sk'ub'anel sb'a heb' winh t'a spatiktak jun chonhab' chi', haxo junokxo makan heb' winh b'at tzuntzanelta heb' kajan chi' ta', xchi Jehová chi' t'a winh.

Yuj chi' ix yak'an lista sb'a winhaj Josué chi' yet' heb' winh soldado yik sb'at heb' yak' owal t'a chonhab' Hai chi', ix sik'anel 30 mil heb' winh soldado winh te jelan t'a owal, ix schekanb'at heb' winh t'ak'walil.
Ix yalan winh t'a heb' winh icha tik: Ab'ek tas ol wala', sb'at he k'ub'ejel he b'a t'a spatiktak jun chonhab' chi', manh najatok tzex eli, lista tzex aji.
Ha inxo yet' juntzanhxo heb' winh soldado tik, ol onh k'och t'a slak'anil jun chonhab' chi'. Ayik ol elta heb' ajk'ol chi' t'ayonh, ol onh el lemnaj t'a heb', icha ix onh yutej heb' t'a sb'ab'elal.
Ayik ol kot heb' t'ayonh, ol onh spechan heb', a sna'an heb' to ol onh yak'xi ganar heb', icha chi' ol kutej ko montanel heb' yik najat tz'elkan heb' t'a schonhab' chi'.
Haxo yik ol eyilan icha chi', ol ex elta b'aj k'ub'an ex chi', haxo eyoch nhilnaj t'a yol chonhab' chi', yujto a Jehová ol ak'anoch jun chonhab' chi' t'a yol ko k'ab'.
Ayik toxo ix ex ochk'och t'a yol jun chonhab' chi', tze nhustz'a icha ix yutej yalan Jehová. Haton tik swal t'ayex, xchi winhaj Josué chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix schekanb'at heb' winh soldado chi' winh. Ix k'och heb' sk'ub'ejel sb'a t'a snanhal Betel yet' Hai chi', t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u. Haxo winh, ix kan winh t'a junxo ak'wal chi' t'a campamento chi'.

Haxo t'a junxo k'u ix pet k'e wa'an winh, ix smolb'an juntzanhxo heb' winh soldado winh. Ixlajwi chi', ix b'ab'laj winh yuj heb' yet' heb' yajalil chonhab'. Ix b'at heb' yik syak'an owal heb' yet' heb' aj Hai chi'.

Masanil heb' winh soldado ajun yet' winhaj Josué chi' ix k'och heb' t'a slak'anilxo jun chonhab' chi' t'a stojolal spuertail, ix sb'oank'e scampamento heb' t'a jun ak'lik t'a stojolal norte. Anhej jun ch'olan ay t'a snanhal heb' yet' jun chonhab' chi'.
Oye' mil heb' winh soldado ix schekb'at winhaj Josué sk'ub'ejel sb'a t'a snanhal Betel yet' Hai chi' t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u.

Yuj chi' chab' makan ix aj heb' winh soldado chi', jun makan heb' ix b'at sk'ub'ejel sb'a t'a spatiktak chonhab' chi' t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u, haxo junxo makan heb', ixto kan heb' t'a yol scampamento t'a stojolal norte. Haxo t'a jun ak'wal chi' ix b'at winhaj Josué chi' yet' heb' winh soldado chi', ix emk'och heb' t'a jun ch'olan chi'.

Haxo yik ix yilanelta winh sreyal Hai chi' to ay tas wan sk'och t'a winh, yuj chi' ix pet k'e wa'an winh, ix yak'an lista masanil heb' winh soldado winh. Ix elta winh yak' owal yet' heb' israel chi' t'a jun ch'olan tz'emk'och t'a sti' ha' Jordán, palta manh yojtakok winh tato ay heb' winh soldado toxo ix sk'ub'ejel sb'a t'a spatik chonhab' chi'.
Haxo ix yilan winhaj Josué chi' sjawi heb', ichato ix xiw winh, elanhchamel ix el lemnaj winh yet' heb' winh soldado, ix b'at heb' t'a stojolal tzinan lu'um.

Yuj chi' haxo winh sreyal Hai chi' ix halani to sb'at masanil heb' aykan t'a yol chonhab' chi' yik spechchaj winhaj Josué yet' heb' winh soldado israel chi', yuj chi' te najat ix el heb' t'a schonhab' chi'.

Manhxa junok winak ix kan t'a yol chonhab' Hai chi' yet' t'a Betel. Masanil heb' ix b'at spech heb' winh soldado israel chi'. Yujto ix b'at heb' smasanil, yuj chi' manhxa mach ix kan stanhwej schonhab' heb' chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Josué chi' icha tik: Ch'oxb'at k'e'en a lanza t'a stojolal chonhab' Hai, yujto swak'och jun chonhab' chi' t'a yol a k'ab', xchi t'a winh. Elanhchamel ix sch'oxb'at k'e'en slanza winh t'a stojolal chonhab' Hai chi'.
Wal t'a jun rato chi' a heb' winh soldado k'ub'anel t'a spatiktak jun chonhab' chi', ix och nhilnaj heb' t'a yo'ol. Ix yak'an ganar heb', ix snhusantz'a heb'.

Haxo yik ix meltzajb'at k'elan heb' winh soldado aj Hai chi', ix yilan heb' wan sk'e stab'il schonhab' heb' chi' stz'ab'ati. Manhxa b'aj ix yal skolan sb'a heb', yujto a heb' israel wan yel t'a heb' chi', ix meltzaj heb' yak' owal yet' heb'.

Haxo ix yilan winhaj Josué chi' to wan sk'e stab'il jun chonhab' chi', ix yojtakanel winh to toxo ix och heb' winh soldado winh t'a yol chonhab' chi'. Yuj chi' ix meltzaj winh yet' heb' winh soldado t'a heb' aj Hai chi', ix och ijan winh smilancham heb'.

Ix eltapax heb' ayxo och t'a yol chonhab' chi' yak' owal, ix meltzajpax heb' pechb'il yuj heb' aj Hai chi'. Yuj chi' ix oymaj heb' israel chi' t'a spatik heb', manhxa junok heb' syal yeli, yuj chi' ix cham heb' smasanil.
Haxonhej winh sreyal Hai chi' pitzan, ix yik'anb'at heb' winh t'a winhaj Josué chi'.
Ayik ix lajwi scham masanil heb' winh soldado ix pechan heb' israel chi', ix b'atxi heb' t'a yol chonhab' chi', ix b'at swach' satanel jantakto anima heb' ix kani.
Ha t'a jun k'u chi', 12 mil heb' aj Hai chi' ix chami, heb' ix ix yet' heb' winh winak.
Maj yik' jab'ok yip winhaj Josué chi' yet' masanil heb' winh soldado, masanto ix yal scham heb' aj Hai chi' smasanil.
Masanil nok' nok' yet' masanil tastak, ix yik'b'at heb' israel chi', icha ix aj yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Josué chi'.
Ix tz'akanb'at masanil chonhab' Hai chi' yuj winhaj Josué chi' yet' heb' winh soldado, ix emkan b'ulnaj stz'ai, haxonhej yet'tal chekel ix ajkani.

Ix k'e lokan winh sreyal Hai chi' t'a sk'ab' jun te te' yuj winhaj Josué chi', masanto t'a yemk'ualil. Haxo yik ix k'ik'b'i, ix schekan winh ik'jokemta winh. Ix yik'anemta sniwanil winh rey chi' heb', ix b'at syumankan heb' t'a spuertail schonhab' chi', ix k'ekan b'ulan k'e'en k'e'en t'a yib'anh winh. Ha jun b'ulanh k'e'en chi' ix kanxonhej k'e'en.
Ixlajwi chi', ix sb'oankank'e jun altar winhaj Josué chi' t'a Jehová sDiosal heb' israel t'a yich lum witz Ebal.

Ix sk'ulej winh icha ajnak yalankan winhaj Moisés schekab' Jehová t'a heb' israel chi', icha yajkan b'aj tz'ib'ab'ilkan jun k'ayb'ub'al icha tik: Ha k'e'en k'e'en manh tzeyb'ilok, a k'e'en tz'och t'a junok altar, xchi jun k'ayb'ub'al chi'. Haxo t'a yib'anh k'e'en chi' ix nhusjitz'a silab' t'a yichanh Jehová, haton silab' stz'ab'at smasanil yet' silab' sch'oxan junk'olal yet' Dios.
T'a yichanh heb' chonhab' ix stz'ib'ejoch jun k'ayb'ub'al winhaj Josué chi' t'a k'e'en k'e'en yik altar chi', haton jun yak'nakkan winhaj Moisés chi' t'a heb' yetisraelal.

Haxo masanil heb' israel, heb' yichamtak winakil chonhab', heb' yajal soldado, heb' juez yet' heb' ch'ok chonhab'il ayek' t'a skal heb', cha makan ix aj spojan sb'a heb' t'a stz'eytak te' skaxail strato Jehová. T'a spatikb'at jun makan heb' ix kan lum witz Gerizim, haxo t'a spatikb'at junxo makan heb' ix kan lum witz Ebal. Ix laj kot k'elan heb' scha makanhil t'a heb' sacerdote yinhtilalkan winhaj Leví b'akhjinak te' skaxail strato Jehová chi', yik syalan wach' lolonel heb' t'a heb' israel chi', icha aj yalannakkan winhaj Moisés, schekab' Jehová.

Ix syamanoch winhaj Josué chi' yawtan jun k'ayb'ub'al yalnakkan winhaj Moisés chi'. Malaj junok lolonel tz'ib'ab'ilkan chi' maj yawtej winh, haton masanil wach' lolonel yet' katab' lolonel. Ix yawtan winh yab' masanil heb' israel, heb' ix ix, heb' unin yet' heb' ch'ok chonhab'il ayek' t'a skal heb'.
